matrix.no_opportunity: retain; do not replace or count as a zero label
matrix.candidate_set: all legal public candidates, including NOOP with task-head masks false
matrix.parent_identity: must be materialized from the frozen W1-light generator and cross-checked against the historical identity registry before external authorization; any collision or unavailable parent stops without substitution

derivation.environment_steps: 8*4 prefix steps + 200*(1 forced first action + 13 horizon-limited continuation steps); M10Config horizon=18s and decision_interval=1s, decision begins no earlier than t=4s
derivation.rule_decisions: 8*4 public NOOP prefix decisions + 200*13 Hungarian continuation decisions; forced candidate first actions are separately counted
derivation.wall_and_cpu: ceil(3x the completed history-repair attempt totals: wall 230.81851591199938s and complete CPU 163.57187984099997s) plus a 60s shutdown reserve, rounded up to whole seconds
derivation.rss: 2x the prior attempt's 771072000-byte peak RSS upper bound, rounded up to 2 GiB
derivation.storage: 2x the prior 193032425-byte verified export, rounded up to 512 MiB active and 1 GiB native plus export

stops: runtime config identity mismatch before reset
public-input, candidate, task, command, or continuation identity mismatch
missing lifecycle evidence remains unknown and cannot be imputed
any no-opportunity parent remains missing; no replacement is allowed
any ledger, filesystem, storage, or time cap failure stops and seals; no retry
approval_basis: This is a bounded label-availability collection request only. It cannot establish model accuracy, action-ranking benefit, or task benefit; those require a separately frozen protocol.
